definitions.meaning: A FIG-WORM, a worm originating from the fig-disease

quotations.old_english: Feallaþ ða fícwyrmas on ða beðinge
quotations.latin: dēcident fīet morbi vermes in balneo

source_text: fíc-wyrm, es; m. A FIG-WORM, a worm originating from the fig-disease; vermis ex f&i-long;co morbo &o-short;riens :-- Feallaþ ða fícwyrmas on ða beðinge d&e-long;c&i-short;dent f&i-long;et morbi vermes in balneo, L. M. 3, 48; Lchdm. ii. 340. 8.
